description: This file defines the class LoanTermVariationsDataWrapper, which manages collections of loan term variations such as interest rate changes, due date variations, and other adjustments. It provides methods for navigating, updating, and processing these variations within a loan management system.

classes.name: LoanTermVariationsDataWrapper
classes.description: Main class that encapsulates collections and logic for handling various loan term variations, including interest rate changes, due date modifications, and pause variations.

methods.name: LoanTermVariationsDataWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing variation lists and deriving variations from the provided exception data.

methods.name: hasVariation
methods.description: Checks if there is a variation applicable from a specific date.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Private helper to determine if there is a variation after a given date using an iterator.

methods.name: hasDueDateVariation
methods.description: Checks if there is a due date variation applicable from a specific date.

methods.name: nextVariation
methods.description: Retrieves the next variation from the main variations list.

methods.name: nextDueDateVariation
methods.description: Gets the next due date variation.

methods.name: previousDueDateVariation
methods.description: Retrieves the previous due date variation.

methods.name: setExceptionData
methods.description: Sets new exception data and recalculates variations.

methods.name: clearTerms
methods.description: Clears all variation lists to reset the object state.

methods.name: adjustNumberOfRepayments
methods.description: Calculates adjustment count for repayments based on variation types.

methods.name: fetchLoanTermDueDateVariationsData
methods.description: Fetches a specific due date variation applicable on a given date.

methods.name: hasExceptionVariation
methods.description: Checks if an exception variation exists for a specific date.

methods.name: updateLoanTermVariationsData
methods.description: Updates exception data list with new variations and re-derives variations.

methods.name: deriveLoanTermVariations
methods.description: Sorts and categorizes exception data into specific variation lists and updates iterators.

methods.name: resetVariations
methods.description: Resets the processed status of all variation data and reinitializes iterators.
